cohort: 1713 neonates born to women with perinatal SARS-CoV-2 infection
finding: Perinatal transmission of SARS-CoV-2 occurred in 8% of neonates, with rooming-in with the mother being a significant risk factor.
mod_finding: No association was found between mode of delivery or type of feeding and SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
